issues_detected.description: Every preprocessing entry and the labeling entry carry source_caveats stating that the described step belongs to the MuSIC cell-map pipeline whose outputs are explicitly not in this release ('the June 2026 release states that computed cell maps are not included in this release, so this step was not applied to the artifacts distributed here'). Three of the five file_collections are nonetheless typed collection_type: processed_data (AP-MS, SEC-MS, perturb-seq archives), so the processing that produced the distributed artifacts is left undocumented apart from the generic statement that data 'undergo quality control before release'.
issues_detected.recommendation: Document the acquisition-to-release processing actually applied to the distributed archives (mass spectrometry search and quantification, elution-profile processing, single-cell read alignment and guide assignment), and keep the MuSIC pipeline description clearly separate as downstream use of the release.

issues_detected.description: No software is named that produced or transformed the data being distributed. The software that is named falls into roles that leave the question unanswered: the 10x Genomics 3'HT kit is capture/instrumentation; the FAIRSCAPE client package packages the release and validates it; the Cell Mapping Toolkit (cellmaps_pipeline), node2vec, the Human Protein Atlas embedding model, the contrastive co-embedding step and the Integrative Modeling Platform belong to pipelines the record itself states produced outputs that are not in this release.
issues_detected.recommendation: Name, with versions, the software that generated the released AP-MS and SEC-MS processed archives and the perturb-seq summaries (for example the MS search engine and quantification tool, and the single-cell processing pipeline), attaching them via used_software on the relevant processing step.

issues_detected.description: No variable-level metadata anywhere in the record: `variables` is absent, `is_tabular` is absent, and no data dictionary or column description is provided for any released archive. A reuser cannot tell what columns or fields the AP-MS, SEC-MS or perturb-seq tables contain.
issues_detected.recommendation: Add variables with identifiers, types and descriptions for the tabular contents of the processed archives, or reference the RO-Crate JSON-Schema documents that define them.

issues_detected.description: `anomalies` is unpopulated. Quality content that exists (incomplete protein-set overlap across modalities, absent cell maps, embargoed links, absent AP-MS for untreated and iPSC conditions) is scope and completeness limitation recorded under known_limitations and missing_data_documentation, not anomaly or outlier documentation. No acquisition-level QC outcome, batch effect, failed-run or artifact assessment is reported.
issues_detected.recommendation: Record data-level anomalies from acquisition QC (failed immunofluorescence wells, low-quality MS runs, guide-assignment dropout rates, batch effects) with their handling.

issues_detected.description: `publisher` is deliberately omitted on source-fidelity grounds ('The bundle names no publisher for the release ... so `publisher` and `last_updated_on` are omitted'), yet the record's own citation string ends 'University of Virginia Dataverse, V2', maintainers records the UVA Dataverse (LibraData) as host, and retention_limit commits it to long-term preservation. The omission is internally inconsistent with the repository named in three other fields.
issues_detected.recommendation: Populate publisher with University of Virginia Dataverse (LibraData), citing the repository named in the release citation.

issues_detected.description: The release is version '2.0' and the citation records 'V2', but `errata` is absent and no change description distinguishes this Dataverse version from its predecessor. What changed is instead scattered in source_caveats (immunofluorescence archives regenerated: same file sizes, different MD5 checksums; AP-MS archives now present where the portal says 'coming soon'; perturb-seq external links now embargoed where June 2025 listed SRA records).
issues_detected.recommendation: Add an errata or release-note entry summarising what changed relative to the October 2025 release and relative to V1 of this DOI, promoting the checksum and content observations out of source_caveats.

issues_detected.description: `download_url` is not populated. Access is nonetheless actionable through `page`, through distribution_formats.access_urls, and through data_governance.access_review_process ('no access request is required for the published files'), but the API entry given, https://dataverse.lib.virginia.edu/api/access/datafile/, is a base endpoint with no datafile identifier and cannot be dereferenced as written.
issues_detected.recommendation: Populate download_url with the Dataverse dataset access endpoint and give a complete, dereferenceable example of the per-file API URL pattern.

issues_detected.description: distribution_formats specify only the container: format 'ZIP archives containing RO-Crate packaged data files and metadata' with media_type application/zip. The formats of the files inside the archives (image format for the confocal data, tabular or MS format for the interaction data) and character encoding are unstated, so format-level interoperability can only be assessed for the packaging and its JSON-LD/RDF-XML/JSON-Schema metadata.
issues_detected.recommendation: List the media types of the files within each archive and their encoding, in addition to the ZIP container.

issues_detected.description: is_deidentified states a determination rather than a method: identifiable_elements_present: false with the rationale that cell-line data 'cannot be matched, with current knowledge, to a human subject'. This is semantically appropriate for commercially sourced cell lines and no removal technique is owed, but donor descriptors are reported for the source lines ('a 51-year-old black female with a metastatic mammary adenocarcinoma'; 'a healthy male Northern European donor') without any accompanying re-identification statement.
issues_detected.recommendation: Note explicitly that the donor descriptors are published characteristics of the ATCC and HipSci lines rather than record-level attributes of the released data.

issues_detected.description: Per-modality instance counts are not asserted at release scope. The record is explicit about why (the June 2026 file listing carries no per-file descriptions, and the immunofluorescence archives were regenerated, so the October 2025 protein counts are not carried over), and it distinguishes project-portal totals from release-scope figures, but a user cannot learn how many images or interactions this release contains.
issues_detected.recommendation: State release-scope counts for each modality (images, baits, elution profiles, cells sequenced) alongside the file-level counts and sizes.

semantic_insights: DOI 10.18130/V3/HIGT4C is well formed and the 10.18130 prefix is the University of Virginia Dataverse (LibraData) installation, consistent with the Dataverse landing page, citation and version_access entries that all resolve to the same prefix.

All four NIH award strings match NIH patterns: 1OT2OD032742-01 and OT2OD032742 (activity code OT2, institute OD), the supplement 3OT2OD032742-01S2, and Bridge Center award 5U54HG012513-02 (U54, institute HG).
Cell-line RRIDs are correctly formed in the Cellosaurus namespace (RRID:CVCL_0419 for MDA-MB-468, RRID:CVCL_B5P3 for KOLF2.1J) and are attached to the specific lines they identify.

The non-human-subjects determination is coherent across the record: human_subject_research.involves_human_subjects: false, is_deidentified.identifiable_elements_present: false, sensitive_elements_present: false, and informed_consent, participant_privacy, participant_compensation and at_risk_populations are all absent rather than asserted hollowly.

License, prohibited uses and IP restrictions are mutually consistent: CC BY-NC-SA 4.0 with data_use_permission no_commercial_use, a prohibited use naming commercial reuse, a ShareAlike redistribution prohibition, and a commercial licensing route through the named copyright holders supervised by a Data Access Committee.

Source provenance discipline is unusually explicit: source_caveats resolve four named source disagreements by stated ranking, separate project-scope portal totals from release-scope figures, and refuse to carry over a protein count when the checksum evidence shows the archives were regenerated.

Temporal ordering is logical: created_on 2025-02-27 falls inside the NIH project period 2022-09-01 to 2026-08-31, precedes issued 2026-06-17, and the split release dates 2026-06-17 and 2026-07-15 match the seven plus three file split described in distribution_dates.

Governance is named and reachable: Data Governance Committee contact Jillian Parker, ethical review contacts Vardit Ravitsky and Jean-Christophe Belisle-Pipon (the latter recorded by ORCID as ethical_reviews.contact_person), point of contact Trey Ideker, program manager Swathi Thaker, and archival steward UVA Dataverse.

AI-readiness framing uses its technical terms correctly: RO-Crate packaging, ARK persistent identifiers per crate, EVI Evidence Graph Ontology provenance serialized as JSON-LD and RDF-XML, dataset schemas in JSON-Schema.

The record distinguishes the two differently named governance bodies in the sources (a 'Data Governance Committee' contact for the release and a future-tense 'Data Access Committee' in the preprint) instead of conflating them.

overall_score.denominator_note: normalized_percentage = 42/47 x 100 (adjusted base); fixed_percentage = 42/50 x 100 (whole-rubric base). Excluded items: Element 4 sub-element 3 (Privacy Protections and Re-identification Risk Assessment), Element 4 sub-element 4 (Informed Consent Obtained from Participants), Element 4 sub-element 5 (Vulnerable Populations and Compensation Documented). The two bases are not interchangeable and neither alone establishes comparability with a record having different excluded items.

sub_elements.semantic_validation: DOI matches 10.XXXX/... ; prefix 10.18130 is the University of Virginia Dataverse (LibraData) installation, plausible for a record whose landing page is dataverse.lib.virginia.edu. RRIDs are valid Cellosaurus-namespace identifiers.

sub_elements.quality_note: Far beyond the 200-character threshold and specific throughout: which modality covers which cell line and condition is stated rather than gestured at.
sub_elements.semantic_validation: Description content matches keywords, instances, file_collections and acquisition_methods; no modality is described that the file listing does not contain.

sub_elements.evidence: page: https://dataverse.lib.virginia.edu/dataset.xhtml?persistentId=doi:10.18130/V3/HIGT4C; five file_collections decomposing the release into immunofluorescence, AP-MS, SEC-MS, perturb-seq and release-metadata archives with per-collection file_count, sizes and compression; total_file_count: 10.

sub_elements.name: Hierarchical Structure (parent datasets, relationships)
sub_elements.evidence: related_datasets: four is_new_version_of links to the October 2025, June 2025, March 2025 and initial releases with DOIs; two is_described_by links to preprints doi:10.1101/2024.05.21.589311 and doi:10.1101/2024.11.03.621734; one references link to doi:10.1038/s41586-025-08878-3.

elements.name: Dataset Access and Retrieval
elements.description: Can the dataset and its associated resources be located, accessed, and downloaded?

sub_elements.name: Access Policy and IP Restrictions Defined
sub_elements.evidence: license_and_use_terms.license_terms: 'Creative Commons Attribution-NonCommercial-ShareAlike 4.0 International (CC BY-NC-SA 4.0)' with the four permission and condition clauses spelled out; data_use_permission: no_commercial_use; ip_restrictions.restrictions: copyright to the Regents of the University of California except where otherwise indicated, raw spatial-proteomics images copyright Stanford, ShareAlike obligation, and commercial licensing through the copyright holder supervised by a Data Access Committee.

sub_elements.semantic_validation: Licence, prohibited_uses and ip_restrictions agree; the record notes the copyright wording is transcribed from the March 2025 release because the June 2026 landing page does not restate it, which is disclosed rather than silently asserted.

sub_elements.name: Regulatory Compliance and Confidentiality Classification
sub_elements.evidence: regulatory_restrictions.confidentiality_level: unrestricted; regulatory_restrictions: 'the dataset does not involve human subjects, that samples are de-identified, and that the data are not FDA regulated' and 'Use of these laboratory data in clinical decision-making or in any context involving patient care requires appropriate regulatory oversight and approval'; other_compliance: FAIR Principles compliance as an NIH requirement, ethical conditions of release, and 'The release names Jillian Parker (jillianparker@health.ucsd.edu) as the Data Governance Committee contact.'
sub_elements.quality_note: Sensitivity classification, the applicable clinical-use constraint, the regulatory status statements and a named, reachable governance contact are all present.
sub_elements.semantic_validation: hipaa_compliant is not asserted, which is semantically appropriate for non-clinical cell-line data; the unrestricted classification is consistent with data_governance.access_review_process stating no access request is required.

sub_elements.name: Download URL or Platform Link Available
sub_elements.evidence: distribution_formats[0].access_urls: https://dataverse.lib.virginia.edu/dataset.xhtml?persistentId=doi:10.18130/V3/HIGT4C; distribution_formats[1]: 'Programmatic file access through the Dataverse data access API, recommended for archives above the web download size limit', access_urls https://dataverse.lib.virginia.edu/api/access/datafile/; data_governance.access_review_process: 'All files in the release are publicly accessible from the University of Virginia Dataverse under CC BY-NC-SA 4.0; no access request is required for the published files.'

The dedicated download_url slot is nevertheless unpopulated and the API entry is a base endpoint without a datafile identifier, recorded as a low-severity issue.
sub_elements.semantic_validation: Access instructions are consistent with third_party_sharing.is_shared: true and with confidentiality_level unrestricted; no contradictory gated-access statement appears.

sub_elements.name: Distribution Formats and File Types Specified
sub_elements.evidence: distribution_formats[0].format: 'ZIP archives containing RO-Crate packaged data files and metadata', media_type: application/zip; file_collections each record compression: zip with file_count and per-archive sizes (4.6 GB, 3.8 GB, 4.2 GB immunofluorescence; 113.3 KB and 135.8 KB AP-MS; 171.8 KB and 93.9 KB SEC-MS; 30.2 KB and 73.3 KB perturb-seq; 1.1 MB metadata).
sub_elements.quality_note: Container format, MIME type and per-archive sizes are specific enough to plan a download; the formats of the files inside the archives are not listed, which is recorded as a low-severity issue rather than a failure of this sub-element.

sub_elements.evidence: related_datasets: seven typed links; external_resources: five groups covering two preprints with DOIs, MassIVE deposits for SEC-MS and AP-MS, a Figshare CRISPRi atlas, two embargoed perturb-seq links with a restrictions note, the CM4AI portal and releases pages, and the Cell Mapping Toolkit, its readthedocs documentation, FAIRSCAPE and the Integrative Modeling Platform.
sub_elements.quality_note: Rich and typed, with archival flags distinguishing archival deposits from project web resources and an explicit embargo restriction on the two perturb-seq links.

sub_elements.applicability_evidence: Datasets-shared condition met on fields outside this sub-element: distribution_formats populated with access_urls, page resolves to the UVA Dataverse landing page, third_party_sharing.is_shared: true, and the CC BY-NC-SA licence explicitly permits share and adapt.

sub_elements.semantic_validation: Licence identifier valid; NC and SA conditions are reflected consistently in prohibited_uses and ip_restrictions.

sub_elements.evidence: distribution_formats: ZIP / application/zip containing RO-Crate packaged files; conforms_to: 'packaged with provenance graphs and rich metadata as AI-ready datasets in RO-Crate format ... expressed in the EVI Evidence Graph Ontology, serialized as JSON-LD and RDF-XML, with dataset schemas expressed in JSON-Schema'; conforms_to_standard: RO_CRATE; file_collections record compression: zip.

The gap is real and flagged: the formats of the data files inside the archives, and character encoding, are never stated, so a reuser learns how the release is packaged but not what the payload files are.
sub_elements.semantic_validation: Terms are used correctly (RO-Crate as packaging, EVI as provenance ontology, JSON-Schema as dataset schema); no format is claimed that conflicts with the stated media type.

sub_elements.applicability_evidence: Datasets-shared condition met (distribution_formats, page, third_party_sharing.is_shared: true).
sub_elements.evidence: conforms_to_standard: RO_CRATE; conforms_to_schema: https://w3id.org/bridge2ai/data-sheets-schema; conforms_to_class: Dataset; conforms_to prose naming RO-Crate, ARK identifiers, the EVI Evidence Graph Ontology and JSON-Schema; instances carry ontology term identifiers B2AI_SUBSTRATE:56/58/59/64 and B2AI_TOPIC:12/15/26/28.

sub_elements.semantic_validation: The declared class Dataset matches the record's own structure; the Bridge2AI substrate and topic CURIEs are used in the right slots for imaging, mass spectrometry and sequencing instances.

sub_elements.name: Variable Metadata with Identifiers Defined
sub_elements.applicability_evidence: Datasets-shared condition met (distribution_formats, page, third_party_sharing.is_shared: true), so variable-level documentation is owed for the distributed archives.
sub_elements.evidence: No `variables` block appears anywhere in the record; no data dictionary, column list or field definition is given for the AP-MS, SEC-MS or perturb-seq archives. The nearest content is instances.instance_type prose and the statement in conforms_to that schemas are 'expressed in JSON-Schema' inside the RO-Crates.

sub_elements.name: Use Guidance Provided (intended, prohibited uses)
sub_elements.evidence: intended_uses: four categories with usage_notes (AI-ready functional genomics, AI model training, cellular process analysis, cross-condition comparison); prohibited_uses: three reasons (no clinical decision-making without regulatory oversight, no commercial use under CC BY-NC-SA, no redistribution under other terms); discouraged_uses: three (analyses requiring computed cell maps, analysis without domain expertise, generalization to the population at large).
sub_elements.quality_note: All three registers of guidance are present, specific, and tied to the release's actual limitations rather than to generic caution.
sub_elements.semantic_validation: Prohibitions track the licence and the regulatory statement exactly; the discouraged use about cell maps matches known_limitations.scope_limitation and missing_data_documentation.

elements.name: Ethical Use and Privacy Safeguards
elements.description: Does the dataset provide clear information about consent, privacy, and ethical oversight?

sub_elements.applicability_evidence: Human-subjects condition fails on E1/E8 evidence: description and keywords name cell lines (MDA-MB-468, KOLF2.1J iPSCs) and assays, not participants or patients, and collection_mechanisms describe endogenous tagging, chromatography, robotic staining and CRISPR screens, not recruitment. The governance condition is met on E2 evidence: regulatory_restrictions state an applying constraint, 'Use of these laboratory data in clinical decision-making or in any context involving patient care requires appropriate regulatory oversight and approval', and other_compliance names a Data Governance Committee contact. Sub-elements 1 and 2 therefore open on the governance disjunct.
sub_elements.evidence: ethical_reviews[0]: reviewing_organization 'CM4AI Ethics module', contact_person ORCID:0000-0002-7080-8801, review_details describing the Value-Sensitive-Design methodology, the axiological repository of values, the CM4AI Life Cycle framework of governance milestones and the mixed empirical research programme; human_subject_research.ethics_review_board: 'Ethical oversight is provided through the CM4AI Ethics module, with review contacts Vardit Ravitsky and Jean-Christophe Belisle-Pipon; no institutional review board approval is recorded for the release, consistent with its statement that no human subjects are involved.'
sub_elements.quality_note: Oversight is documented as an identifiable body with named, contactable reviewers and a described methodology, and the absence of IRB approval is explained rather than left as a hole. data_protection_impacts is absent, which is coherent for non-clinical cell-line data.
sub_elements.semantic_validation: Consistency check: involves_human_subjects is false, so the rule requiring IRB approval when it is true does not fire; the ethics documentation that is present exceeds what the false flag would require.

sub_elements.name: Deidentification Method Described
sub_elements.applicability_evidence: Same governance disjunct as sub-element 1: regulatory_restrictions (E2) state an applying clinical-use constraint and name a governance committee contact, while the human-subjects condition fails on E1 description/keywords and E8 collection_mechanisms.
sub_elements.evidence: is_deidentified.identifiable_elements_present: false; deidentification_details: 'The release states that samples are de-identified. All data derive from commercially available human cell lines, MDA-MB-468 obtained from ATCC and KOLF2.1J iPSCs from the Human Induced Pluripotent Stem Cells Initiative resource. The project states that such data are non-clinical and are considered de-identified because they cannot be matched, with current knowledge, to a human subject.' Corroborated by human_subject_research.regulatory_compliance: 'Human Subjects: No; De-identified Samples: Yes; FDA Regulated: No.'
sub_elements.quality_note: No removal technique such as Safe Harbor is named, and none is owed: the record explains the basis of the determination, names the provenance of both lines, and states the knowledge-dependent limit of the claim. That is a substantive, non-boilerplate account appropriate to the data type.
sub_elements.semantic_validation: Method appropriateness check passes for cell-line material. Low-severity note: donor descriptors for the source lines are reported in raw_data_sources without an accompanying re-identification statement.

sub_elements.name: Privacy Protections and Re-identification Risk Assessment
sub_elements.applicability_evidence: Human-subjects condition fails on evidence outside Element 4: the E1 description characterises two commercially available cell lines and their treatment and differentiation states; E1 keywords name assays, cell lines and drugs with no participant, patient or clinical-research term; E8 collection_mechanisms describe AP-MS on tagged lines, SEC-MS, robotic immunofluorescence staining and CRISPR screens, with no recruitment. The governance structure recorded in E2 and data_governance does not reach this sub-element: a Data Access Committee and a governance contact over a dataset with no participants do not create participants whose privacy could be documented.
sub_elements.evidence: participant_privacy and participant_privacy.reidentification_risk are absent, as are participants: raw_data_sources identify ATCC and HipSci cell lines, and direct_collection.is_direct: false with 'Data were not collected from individuals.'

sub_elements.applicability_evidence: Same E1/E8 finding: no participants are described or recruited anywhere in description, keywords or collection_mechanisms, and direct_collection.is_direct: false states 'Data were not collected from individuals.' The E2 governance constraint does not extend to this sub-element under the per-sub-element gate.
sub_elements.evidence: informed_consent is absent; the record instead documents cell-line acquisition terms, including that KOLF2.1J is 'available for access by non-for-profit organizations via a simple MTA'.
sub_elements.quality_note: Excluded from the denominator (-1). There is no consent event to document for commercially sourced lines obtained under material transfer terms.

sub_elements.applicability_evidence: Same E1/E8 finding: no human participants are described or recruited, so there is no at-risk population enrolled and no one to compensate. The governance disjunct does not reach sub-elements 3 to 5.
sub_elements.evidence: at_risk_populations and participant_compensation are absent; the only population language in the record is known_biases.representation_bias about biological variants not represented by two donor-derived cell lines.

elements.name: Data Composition and Structure
elements.description: Can the dataset's structure, modality, and population be understood from metadata?

sub_elements.name: Cohort or Subpopulations Characteristics Described
sub_elements.evidence: raw_data_sources: 'MDA-MB-468 (RRID:CVCL_0419), a triple negative breast cancer cell line established from a metastatic site pleural effusion of a 51-year-old black female with a metastatic mammary adenocarcinoma' and 'KOLF2.1J (RRID:CVCL_B5P3), an induced pluripotent stem cell line derived from a healthy male Northern European donor, used undifferentiated and differentiated into neural progenitor cells, neurons and cardiomyocytes'; description enumerates the three MDA-MB-468 treatment arms and the five iPSC states; file_collections map archives onto those arms (untreated 4.6 GB, paclitaxel 3.8 GB, vorinostat 4.2 GB; SEC-MS split iPSC-derivatives vs MDA-MB-468).
sub_elements.quality_note: The biological populations and their sub-groupings are characterised with identifiers, donor characteristics, disease context and the condition arms each archive belongs to, which answers the sub-element's question in substance. The structured `subpopulations` list and subset subpopulation flags are nonetheless unpopulated, so the grouping is not machine-extractable; recorded as an issue.
sub_elements.semantic_validation: Cell-line RRIDs resolve to the lines named; the donor characteristics match the published provenance of these lines and are reported as line attributes rather than as record-level data.

sub_elements.name: Number of Instances or Samples Reported
sub_elements.evidence: total_file_count: 10 with per-collection file_count 3/2/2/2/1 and per-archive byte sizes; instances: 'the KOLF2.1J iPSC perturbation cell atlas maps transcriptional and fitness phenotypes associated with 11,739 targeted genes'; sampling_strategies: 'Genome-scale CRISPR interference screening of 11,739 expressed genes ... 6 guide RNAs per gene'; collection_mechanisms: 'tagging 17 genes in MDA-MB-468 with AP-MS'; notes separates project-wide portal totals (1,374 protein interactions, 53,788 immunofluorescent images, 7,023 proteins, 21.4 TB) from release scope.
sub_elements.quality_note: Specific counts are reported at stated scope, and the record is explicit that per-modality release-scope counts (for example the number of imaged proteins) are deliberately not asserted because the June 2026 listing carries no per-file descriptions and the archives were regenerated. Careful scope discipline, with the residual gap recorded as a low-severity issue.
sub_elements.semantic_validation: The 11,739 figure is flagged by the record itself as coinciding at two different scopes; file counts reconcile with total_file_count.

sub_elements.name: Variable-Level Metadata, Tabular Flag, and Data Splits

strengths: Identifier and attribution hygiene is excellent: a consistently used Dataverse DOI, valid Cellosaurus RRIDs for both cell lines, 38 ORCIDs and ROR affiliations across 47 creators, and four NIH award strings that all match NIH format including the supplement and the Bridge Center U54.

Source discipline is unusual and verifiable: source_caveats resolve four named source conflicts by declared ranking, separate project-scope portal totals from release-scope figures, and decline to carry over a protein count once checksum evidence shows the archives were regenerated.

The non-human-subjects determination is coherent end to end, with human_subject_research, is_deidentified, sensitive_elements, direct_collection and the absence of consent and privacy blocks all agreeing, and with ethics oversight still documented through a named module and reachable reviewers.

Terms of use are complete and mutually consistent: CC BY-NC-SA 4.0 with clause-level restatement, no_commercial_use permission, institution-level copyright allocation, a ShareAlike redistribution condition and a named route to commercial licensing.

Limitations, biases, missing data and use guidance form a single consistent story: the interim status, the incomplete modality overlap, the embargo and the two-cell-line basis appear in known_limitations, missing_data_documentation, known_biases, discouraged_uses and future_use_impacts without contradiction.

Provenance and versioning are strong: five DOI-addressable releases, an explained quarterly versioning model, a persistence guarantee for superseded files, RO-Crate/EVI provenance graphs and four documented upstream raw-data sources.
weaknesses: The processing documentation describes the wrong pipeline: every preprocessing entry and the labeling entry are caveated as belonging to the MuSIC cell-map pipeline whose outputs are not in this release, leaving three processed_data archives with no account of how they were produced.

No software that produced or transformed the released data is named anywhere; the tools that are named are capture instrumentation, release packaging and validation, or pipelines whose outputs the record excludes from this release.

No variable-level metadata of any kind: `variables` and `is_tabular` are absent and no data dictionary or schema document is linked, so the contents of the released tables are opaque without downloading them.
`anomalies` is empty and no data-level quality assessment (acquisition QC outcomes, artifacts, batch effects, dropout) is reported for any modality.

`publisher` and `download_url` are unpopulated even though the repository is named in the citation and maintainers and the access route is described elsewhere; and the API access URL given is a base endpoint that cannot be dereferenced as written.

No errata or change note distinguishes version 2.0 from its predecessor; the genuinely useful change observations (regenerated image archives, newly included AP-MS, newly embargoed perturb-seq links) are buried in source_caveats.
Release-scope instance counts are absent for every modality, so a user cannot size the imaging, interaction or single-cell content without downloading it.
recommendations: Document the processing that produced the distributed archives — MS search, quantification and elution-profile construction for the SEC-MS and AP-MS data, and read alignment and guide assignment for the perturb-seq summaries — and keep the MuSIC pipeline description explicitly as downstream use of the release rather than as its provenance.

Name that processing software with versions, attaching it via used_software on the relevant preprocessing or cleaning step, so a reader can tell what transformed the released data rather than what packaged or validated it.

Add variables with identifiers, types and descriptions for the tabular contents of each archive, or link the RO-Crate JSON-Schema documents that already define them, and set is_tabular where it applies.

Populate anomalies with acquisition-level QC outcomes (failed wells or runs, low-confidence baits, guide dropout, batch effects) and how they were handled, keeping scope and completeness statements in known_limitations.

Populate publisher with University of Virginia Dataverse (LibraData) as the citation already states, populate download_url, and give a complete dereferenceable example of the per-file Dataverse API URL.

Add an errata or release-note entry recording what changed relative to the October 2025 release and relative to V1 of this DOI, promoting the regenerated-archive and newly-included-AP-MS observations out of source_caveats.

State release-scope counts for each modality (images, baits, elution profiles, cells sequenced) alongside the existing file counts and sizes, retaining the current explicit separation from project-wide portal totals.
